text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss

- Switzerland's annual inflation rose to 0.6 percent from 0.5 percent in May. - Seidenstoffweberei Gessner AG, a silk weaving firm, acquired a majority share in Seidendruckerei Mitloedi AG. - After major restructuring, Winterthur Insurance Group posted good results for the first five months of 1997 and expects the trend to continue.
- Switzerland's Social Minister Ruth Dreifuss wants health insurance firms to raise the minimum deductible to 250 Swiss francs from 150 as of 1998 in an effort to keep premiums from rising too fast.
- Fritz Leutwiler, former president of the Swiss National Bank and head of ABB, died at the age of 73.
- Homosexuals in Switzerland are demanding more protection against discrimination and will demonstrate on Saturday at the Bundeshaus in Berne. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
